name: SOSAM
subtext: Segment Organs with Segment Anything Models.
description: Project to determine the feasibility of segmenting three dimensional medical images using two dimensional SAM models. Work involved slicing 3D volumes from a dataset of over 200 images and preprocessing slices using various methods. 2026 team project.

0.alt: A sample slice of a CT scan. A blue box is drawn around the organ of interest.

1.alt: A sample slice of a segmented liver. A blue box is drawn around the liver.
